currentRoundInspection.scope: Neues Museum connected exterior on its exact PMTiles footprint: warm pale stone and restrained restored brick, three facade levels, central east/west pediments and tall grouped window bays, shared mapped U-shaped outdoor colonnade with open gaps and original terrain under its roof, dark shallow wing roofs, two broad blue-green glazed court roofs, raised central gabled hall and two low corner dome/skylight forms. Covered courts remain covered; no invented open courtyard, copied relief figures/inscriptions, banners, furnished galleries or neighboring James-Simon-Galerie/Alte Nationalgalerie/Pergamon geometry.
